options.description: Do not exit with an error code if the provided selector has no matching releases
name: --help
-h

options.description: Set chart. Uses the chart set in release by default, and is available in template as {{ .Chart }}
name: --chart
-c

options.description: Enable verbose output for Helm and set log-level to debug, this disables --quiet/-q effect
options.name: --debug

options.description: Show live output from the Helm binary Stdout/Stderr into Helmfile own Stdout/Stderr. It only applies for the Helm CLI commands, Stdout/Stderr for Hooks are still displayed only when it's execution finishes
options.name: --enable-live-output

options.description: Specify the environment name. defaults to default
name: --environment
-e

options.description: Load config from file or directory. defaults to helmfile.yaml or `helmfile.d`(means `helmfile.d/*.yaml`) in this preference
name: --file
-f

options.description: Request confirmation before attempting to modify clusters
name: --interactive
-i

options.description: Set kubectl context. Uses current context by default
options.name: --kube-context

options.description: Set log level, default info (default info)
options.name: --log-level

options.description: Set namespace. Uses the namespace set in the context by default, and is available in templates as {{ .Namespace }}
name: --namespace
-n

options.description: Silence output. Equivalent to log-level warn
name: --quiet
-q

options.description: Only run using the releases that match labels. Labels can take the form of foo=bar or foo!=bar
name: --selector
-l

options.description: Specify state values in a YAML file
options.name: --state-values-file

options.description: Set state values on the command line (can specify multiple or separate values with commas: key1=val1,key2=val2)
options.name: --state-values-set
